words.zh: adj. 图像的；图标的；符号的；偶像的；标志性的
words.example: The Sydney Opera House is an iconic building that attracts millions of visitors.

words.zh: n. 地基；基础；基金会；建立；粉底
words.example: The foundation of the ancient building was made of large stone blocks.

words.zh: adj. 政治的；政府的；党派的；关心政治的
words.example: The political system of Australia is quite different from that of China.

words.zh: adj. 位于
words.example: The famous beach is located near the southern coast of Australia.

words.zh: n. 赤道
words.example: Countries near the equator usually have a hot and humid climate.

words.zh: n. 烧烤架；烧烤；户外烧烤；烤肉；  v. 烧烤；红烧
words.example: We had a barbecue on the beach to celebrate the end of the school year.

words.zh: n. 面包房，面包店；面包厂
words.example: The bakery on the corner sells fresh bread and cakes every morning.

words.zh: v. 结合，联合；为…装上接头，使…有接缝；  n. 关节；接合处；（尤指廉价的）公共场所；  adj. 联合的，共同的
words.example: The two schools held a joint science fair to showcase their students' projects.

words.zh: n. 屠夫，肉贩子；刽子手；  v. 屠宰；屠戮，残杀
words.example: The butcher cuts the meat and wraps it for his customers every day.

words.zh: n. 总理，首相；  adj. 第一的，首位的；最著名的；最好的；最重要的；最成功的
words.example: The premier of the state announced a new plan to improve public transport.

words.zh: n. 草本植物；药草；香草；大麻
words.example: Fresh herb leaves add a wonderful flavor to the grilled fish.

words.zh: adj. 中间空的，空心的；空洞的；  v. 掏空；  n. 洞；孔；  adv. 完全地，彻底地
words.example: The tree trunk was hollow, so the children could hide inside it.

words.zh: v. 【物】振动；  vi. 回响；颤动，震动，摇摆，踌躇；  vt. （使）振动；（使）摇摆
words.example: His mobile phone began to vibrate during the important science lecture.

words.zh: n. （牛、羊的）角，号角；喇叭；角制作而成的东西；（乐器）号
words.example: The driver sounded the horn to warn the pedestrian at the crossing.

words.zh: v. 投掷，扔；用沥青覆盖；【音】为……定音高；扎营；推销；  n. 投掷；球场；沥青，柏油；音高；程度，强度，高度；路演，推介，提案
words.example: The fans cheered as the pitcher began to pitch the ball toward home plate.

words.zh: adj. 直率的；坦率的；笔直的；正直的；简单的
words.example: The instructions for the science experiment were straightforward enough for everyone.

words.zh: n. 标语；口号；广告语
words.example: The environmental club chose a powerful slogan to encourage recycling at school.

words.zh: v. 照料，服侍；给予援助，救助；  n. 部长，大臣；公使，外交使节；牧师
words.example: The minister visited the flooded areas and promised more aid for families.

words.zh: n. 总理；首相
words.example: The prime minister addressed the nation about the new education policy.

words.zh: n. 青蛙
words.example: We spotted a green frog hopping near the pond during biology class.

words.zh: n. 箭；箭头；【化】箭头，箭号
words.example: The map shows a red arrow pointing to the entrance of the national park.

words.zh: v. 给（书）题名；给予……权利；授予……头衔 ；使符合资格
words.example: This ticket entitles you to visit both the museum and the art gallery.

words.zh: n. 逃走；逃跑；短假；适合度假的地方
words.example: After exams, our family plans a weekend getaway to the mountains.

words.zh: v. 俯冲；假摔；越塔；跳水，暴跌；  vi. 跳水；潜水，下潜；俯冲；急剧下降；扑向，急冲进；热情投身于；  n. 跳水；潜水；俯冲；骤降
words.example: Tourists can dive near the coral reef to see colorful fish.

words.zh: phr. 旺季；高峰季节
words.example: Hotel prices rise sharply during peak season in this coastal town.

words.zh: n. 自由；自主；不受……影响的状态
words.example: The bird enjoyed its freedom after being released from the small cage.

words.zh: n. （知识等的）领域，范围；领土；管区，势力圈；（网络、数学上的）域，定义域；【生】领域，域；【数】定义域
words.example: The theory of evolution belongs to the domain of biological science.

words.zh: v. 捐助；  vt. 发起；倡议；做……的保人；主办；赞助；资助；  n. 倡导者；提案人；赞助人；担保人；教父，教母；捐款者；赞助商；赞助者
words.example: Several local companies sponsor the school's annual sports tournament.

words.zh: n. 自由；冒昧，失礼；特许权，特权；自由权
words.example: Citizens enjoy the liberty to express their opinions in a democracy.

words.zh: n. 高尔夫球运动
words.example: On weekends, my uncle plays golf with his friends at the country club.

words.zh: n. 海峡；窘迫
words.example: The ferry crossed the narrow strait between the two islands safely.

words.zh: v. 【化】取样；  vt. 抽样检查；抽取……的试样；品尝，体验，尝试；  n.  (用于检验、分析的) 试样，样品；【物】样本；【电】样值；  adj. 样品的，作为例子的
words.example: During the field trip, we will sample local fruits at the market.

words.zh: n. 纪念碑；历史遗迹，遗址
words.example: The ancient monument attracts thousands of visitors every summer.

words.zh: n. 猕猴桃，奇异果；几维（新西兰鸟）；  adj. 〈非正式〉与新西兰或新西兰人有关的
words.example: The kiwi is a flightless bird that lives only in New Zealand.

words.zh: adj. 一群（羊或鸟）；许多
words.example: A flock of seagulls followed the fishing boat back to the harbor.

words.zh: n. 分布，分配；分发；散布；分销；【化】分布，浓度分布
words.example: The distribution of rainfall affects the types of plants in each region.

words.zh: n. 小袋 ；荷包；育儿袋（尤指袋鼠等的）；  v. 把……装入袋中，使成袋状
words.example: A kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch until it grows older.

words.zh: adj. 临时的；暂时的；短暂的；【化】临时的
words.example: The library is in a temporary building while the main one is repaired.

words.zh: n. （月亮的）变相；盈亏；方面；阶段，时期；（物理）相；相位；【物】相位
words.example: The first phase of the project involves collecting data from local rivers.

words.zh: n. 树干；象鼻；（人）躯干；大衣箱；主体；（车的）后备箱；汽车车尾的行李箱；躯干
words.example: The elephant uses its trunk to drink water and pick up branches.

words.zh: v. 动词license的过去式和过去分词；  adj. 得到正式许可的
words.example: The tour guide is licensed to lead visitors into the national reserve.

words.zh: n. 许可；许可证；执照；  v. 许可，准许；发许可证；发执照
words.example: You need a special license to operate that kind of radio equipment.

words.zh: n. 一段时间的（活动）；（法庭的）开庭；一场；会议；学期；讲习会；课程；  adj. 为录音的歌手或乐队伴奏的
words.example: The afternoon training session was cancelled because of the heavy rain.

words.zh: n. 频繁；频次；（声波或电磁波振动的）频率；发生率；重复率；【物】频率；【电】频率；【数】频率
words.example: The frequency of earthquakes is higher in some coastal regions.

words.zh: adj. 强烈的，猛烈的；暴力的，粗暴的
words.example: The storm became so violent that all flights were delayed until morning.

words.zh: n. 暴力，暴行；激烈；强暴；巨大的破坏力
words.example: The documentary highlights the harmful effects of violence on young people.

words.zh: n. 巢；温床；鸟窝；秘密窝点；家，安乐窝；  v. 筑巢；嵌入
words.example: The robin built its nest in the tree outside our classroom window.

words.zh: n. 哺乳动物
words.example: The whale is a mammal that breathes air and feeds its young with milk.

words.zh: n. 生物学；（某种动物、植物等的）生活规律，生理习性；(机体、细胞的) 作用方式；【生】生物学
words.example: In biology class, we studied how plants convert sunlight into energy.

words.zh: n. 船舱盖；孵化舱口；  vi. 孵出，孵；破壳；  v. 策划，（尤指）密谋；使孵出
words.example: The chicks hatch from their eggs after three weeks of incubation.

words.zh: n. 产能；容量；本领；才能；负载量；职位；能力；【财】能力，生产力；【法】行为能力，资格；【数】容量；【航】容量
words.example: The new auditorium has a seating capacity of five hundred students.

words.zh: phr. 少数人（或物）；一把（的量）
words.example: Only a handful of students attended the optional Saturday review session.

words.zh: n. 篱笆，围栏，栅栏；  v. 击剑；用篱笆围住；束缚
words.example: The farmer built a wooden fence to keep the sheep from wandering off.

words.zh: n. 监狱；监禁；看守所；【财】收监；  v. 监禁
words.example: The novel tells the story of a man who escaped from prison during the war.

words.zh: adj. 壮丽的，宏伟的，宏大的；重大的；主要的；傲慢的；大的；  n. 一千美元；大钢琴
words.example: The palace has a grand entrance hall decorated with gold and marble.
